svg.aria-label: A remote workspace: one device has the files, another draws the same tree over a tailnet
svg.title: A remote workspace: one device has the files, another draws the same tree over a tailnet
svg.desc: Two windows showing the same file tree. The device on the left has the files. It sends the rows in view, then changes, to another device, which draws the same tree. This uses the same protocol as the MessagePort, over your tailnet on truffle, and each shared folder is read-only or read-write.
